Save as index.html and open it. It is complete and has no dependencies. ```html

Score: 0

```
Add WASD controls and a pause button.

Replace the script with this version; it keeps the same HTML and adds WASD plus Space pause.
```html
<script>let x=200,y=200,dx=20,dy=0,a=[[200,200]],f=[100,100],sc=0,paused=false,C=c.getContext('2d');onkeydown=e=>{let k=e.key.toLowerCase();if(k==' '){paused=!paused;return}if((k=='w'||e.key=='ArrowUp')&&dy==0)[dx,dy]=[0,-20];if((k=='s'||e.key=='ArrowDown')&&dy==0)[dx,dy]=[0,20];if((k=='a'||e.key=='ArrowLeft')&&dx==0)[dx,dy]=[-20,0];if((k=='d'||e.key=='ArrowRight')&&dx==0)[dx,dy]=[20,0]};function loop(){if(paused)return;x=(x+dx+400)%400;y=(y+dy+400)%400;a.unshift([x,y]);if(x==f[0]&&y==f[1])sc++,f=[Math.floor(Math.random()*20)*20,Math.floor(Math.random()*20)*20];else a.pop();if(a.slice(1).some(p=>p[0]==x&&p[1]==y))location.reload();C.fillStyle='#07111f';C.fillRect(0,0,400,400);C.fillStyle='#39ffcc';a.forEach(p=>C.fillRect(p[0]+1,p[1]+1,18,18));C.fillStyle='#ff4fa3';C.fillRect(f[0]+3,f[1]+3,14,14);s.textContent='Score: '+sc+(paused?' (paused)':'')}setInterval(loop,110)</script>
```

Prevent rapid opposite turns from causing a self collision.

Use a queued direction. Replace `turn` and begin each tick by consuming `next`. This allows only one legal turn per frame.
```html
<script>let next=d;function turn(x,y){if(x!=-d[0]||y!=-d[1])next=[x,y]}/* first line inside the interval callback: d=next; */</script>
```
Build Snake with a grid toggle and a selectable color theme.

The controls are plain HTML, so the file works offline.
```html
<!doctype html><select id=theme><option value='#5f5'>Green</option><option value='#5cf'>Blue</option></select><button id=grid>Grid</button><canvas id=c width=400 height=400></canvas><script>let show=true,b=[[200,200]],d=[20,0],f=[100,100],C=c.getContext('2d');theme.onchange=()=>{};grid.onclick=()=>show=!show;onkeydown=e=>{let z={ArrowUp:[0,-20],ArrowDown:[0,20],ArrowLeft:[-20,0],ArrowRight:[20,0]}[e.key];if(z&&z[0]!=-d[0]&&z[1]!=-d[1])d=z};setInterval(()=>{let h=[(b[0][0]+d[0]+400)%400,(b[0][1]+d[1]+400)%400];if(b.some(p=>p+''==h+''))return location.reload();b.unshift(h);if(h+''==f+'')f=[Math.random()*20|0,Math.random()*20|0].map(n=>n*20);else b.pop();C.fillStyle='#101820';C.fillRect(0,0,400,400);if(show){C.strokeStyle='#26323b';for(let i=0;i<400;i+=20){C.beginPath();C.moveTo(i,0);C.lineTo(i,400);C.stroke();C.beginPath();C.moveTo(0,i);C.lineTo(400,i);C.stroke()}}C.fillStyle=theme.value;b.forEach(p=>C.fillRect(p[0]+2,p[1]+2,16,16));C.fillStyle='#f65';C.fillRect(f[0]+4,f[1]+4,12,12)},120)</script>
```

Write a two-player Snake game on one canvas, player two using WASD.

This file has independent snakes, foods, and controls.
```html
<!doctype html><canvas id=c width=500 height=300></canvas><script>let A={b:[[100,140]],d:[20,0],f:[300,100],k:{w:[0,-20],s:[0,20],a:[-20,0],d:[20,0]}},B={b:[[400,140]],d:[-20,0],f:[200,200],k:{ArrowUp:[0,-20],ArrowDown:[0,20],ArrowLeft:[-20,0],ArrowRight:[20,0]}},C=c.getContext('2d');onkeydown=e=>[A,B].forEach(p=>{let z=p.k[e.key];if(z&&z[0]!=-p.d[0]&&z[1]!=-p.d[1])p.d=z});setInterval(()=>{C.fillStyle='#111';C.fillRect(0,0,500,300);[A,B].forEach((p,i)=>{let h=[(p.b[0][0]+p.d[0]+500)%500,(p.b[0][1]+p.d[1]+300)%300];p.b.unshift(h);if(h+''==p.f+'')p.f=[Math.random()*25|0,Math.random()*15|0].map((n,j)=>n*(j?20:20));else p.b.pop();C.fillStyle=i?'#f77':'#7f7';p.b.forEach(q=>C.fillRect(...q,18,18));C.fillStyle=i?'#f0f':'#ff0';C.fillRect(...p.f,18,18)})},130)</script>
```
Make snakes collide with each other and display the winner.

Before updating either snake, check head positions against both bodies. A simple shared loser flag is enough.
```html
<script>/* inside the interval, after computing each new head: let heads=[A,B].map(p=>[(p.b[0][0]+p.d[0]+500)%500,(p.b[0][1]+p.d[1]+300)%300]); if(heads[0]+''==heads[1]+'') alert('Draw'); else if(A.b.concat(B.b).some(p=>p+''==heads[0]+'')) alert('Blue wins'); */</script>
```

The timer movement is awkward. Use one game loop with a frame accumulator instead.

Replace both intervals with this single loop. Movement runs every 110 ms while the displayed timer updates from elapsed time.
```html
<script>let last=performance.now(),acc=0;function frame(now){let dt=now-last;last=now;acc+=dt;if(!over){time=30-(now-start)/1000;if(time<=0)over=1;if(acc>110){acc=0;/* move the head, eat fruit, and redraw here */}ui.textContent=over?'Time up! Score '+n:`${Math.ceil(time)}s · Score ${n}`}requestAnimationFrame(frame)}let start=performance.now();requestAnimationFrame(frame)</script>
```
